in_sanskrit.name: Giaandeep
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God's bounty
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Giaandeep एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Giaandeep is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Gian' meaning knowledge and 'Deep' meaning ocean or wealth. This name signifies the bounty bestowed upon an individual by the divine, signifying knowledge and wealth in abundance.
